items.html: And behold, from Keter to Netzah, which are the clarified Sefirot, there are eight; therefore eight months are needed until Hod is clarified, and its light will be divided and pass through the eight Sefirot mentioned above; and likewise eight months for the Sefira of Yesod, and likewise eight months for the Sefira of Malchut. That makes twenty-four months of the days of the Yenika.
